note: Place names that occur in two or more entries. Entry 15 Koḥlit is Puech restoration only; entry 23 Shlomo links to Sekakah only under the Solomon reading.

clusters.name: Koḥlit
clusters.proposals: Tell es-Sultan (Puech hypothesis); Carmel spring (Milik); Transjordan (Goranson); Samarian desert (Zissu); unidentified (Eshel). No Arabic survival claimed [e4-kohlit, e60-kohlit]

clusters.name: Sekakah (Secacah)
clusters.proposals: Kh. Qumran (Puech) / Wadi Qumran (Milik 1960) / Kh. es-Samra for the biblical town (Milik 1962). No Arabic survival claimed [e20-valley, e21-sekakah]

clusters.name: ha-Melaḥ (Millo? salt?)
clusters.proposals: Temple Esplanade / Millo (Milik, Puech); 'salt' (Puech 2002). Note: Josh 15:62 ʿIr ha-Melaḥ is often placed at Kh. Qumran in scholarship (to verify; not in shared files)

clusters.name: Achor (ʿEmeq ʿAkor)
clusters.proposals: No Arabic survival claimed; located by tradition at Wadi Nuweiʿimeh (Milik, Puech) or el-Buqeiʿa (Allegro, Eshel) [readings.json e1-achor, e17-achor]
